record.paper_title: Exchange Bias and Interface-related Effects in Two-dimensional van der Waals Magnetic Heterostructures: Open Questions and Perspectives
record.original_question: What role does interlayer spin coupling play in setting the exchange-bias effect in ferromagnet/antiferromagnet van der Waals systems?

evidence.quote: x. What is the role of interlayer spin coupling on the EB effect in FM/AFM vdW systems?

artifact.category_tag: van der Waals magnetic heterostructures / exchange bias
artifact.status_search_result: Recent experimental and theoretical studies (2023–2025) demonstrate that interlayer exchange coupling between a vdW AFM (e.g., CrSBr, FePSe3, CrPS4) and a vdW FM (e.g., Fe3GeTe2) is essential for generating exchange bias, with pressure tuning of the vdW gap enhancing H_EB and the blocking temperature, and orthogonal anisotropies leading to switchable/tilted EB states. However, a complete quantitative model linking the microscopic interlayer J_⊥, stacking order, and layer parity to the magnitude, sign, and temperature dependence of the exchange bias remains an open question.

status_evidence.title: Exchange Bias in Weakly Interlayer-Coupled van der Waals Magnet Fe3GeTe2
status_evidence.snippet: Exchange bias in vdW Fe3GeTe2 attributed to weak interlayer coupling.
status_evidence.claim: Interlayer coupling identified as a key control parameter for EB in vdW FM.

status_evidence.title: Switchable Exchange Bias from Correlated Domain Structures in Orthogonally Coupled AFM/FM vdW Heterostructures
status_evidence.snippet: Robust asymmetric magnetization reversal and exchange bias in FGT driven by interlayer exchange coupling with A-type AFM CrSBr.
status_evidence.claim: Interlayer exchange coupling between vdW AFM and FM produces switchable EB; mechanism still under active study.

status_evidence.title: Manipulating exchange bias in 2D magnetic heterojunction
status_evidence.snippet: Pressure tuning of vdW spacing in FePSe3/Fe3GeTe2 strongly enhances EB field and blocking temperature.
status_evidence.claim: H_EB and blocking temperature are tunable via interlayer coupling, but a complete predictive theory is lacking.
